Nang Cua is 5 stars!
May 2024 • Friends
- We came because it had a 5 rating stars.
- This is one of the best seafood meals we've had.
- Seafood, the vibe and service, one of our favorite places to eat in SaiGon!
- If you're a seafood foodie, try to come here for the freshest, premium seafood, that the creative chef's have figured what thoughtful combinations of exclusive ingredients to plate-up and how best to cook-it-up. It tasted as delicious as it looked!
- Feels and smells refreshing, clean, light and so friendly.
And service with a smile.

Thank you Nang Cua chefs (it's so hard to pronounce local language :))) and servers for great dining experience.

Recommend choosing this restaurant
Nov 2023 • Friends
Nang Cua Restaurant is not only a culinary destination, but also a delicious adventure for crab food lovers. The crab dishes here are not simply a meal, but a sophisticated and unique experience.
The unique feature of Nang Cua is the creativity in the way they handle and process crabs. Each dish reflects the chef's meticulousness and dedication. In particular, Crab Rice here is a culinary masterpiece with fresh crab, delicious rice mixed with unique spices.
